Hi all.

I was wondering if any of you good folks could help me out. As a small
little pet project to fill time I'm trying to put together a list of all the

On a Darkling Plain is as much canon as any of the other novels, AIUI.

That is, it is pseudo canon, just like all the other novels.

Where a pseudu canon source doesn't contradict other "full" canon
sources, the pseudo canon source is considered canon.
